body_markdown:
Hey all,


You can now build browser extensions in Opera Neon without writing any code.


Meet **Extension Builder** , now available in Opera Neon. Describe the extension you want in chat, see it in a preview, and install it in your browser with one click. You don’t need to know how to code or fiddle with manual installation steps.


## **What is Opera’s Extension Builder?**


Opera has been a pioneer with web technologies. Now we’re bringing that to browser extensions, and opening extension-making up to everyone, not just developers.


### **Here’s how it works**


Tell Neon what you want your extension to make, and it builds it for you. Before you install anything, a preview shows you how it looks.


Other AI systems can write extensions, but getting from code to a working extension takes several manual steps. Extension Builder in Opera Neon takes you from idea to installed extension seamlessly.


### **How do I use it?**


1. Make sure Opera Neon is updated to the latest version.
2. Ask Neon to build an extension, by writing so in Neon’s chat.
3. When it’s done, click **“Load To Browser.”**


1. Click the extensions icon in the toolbar and select your new extension. Click the pin icon next to it to keep it in the toolbar.


1. Use your extension.


### **Want to change something?**


Ask Neon in the same chat that built the extension. When it’s done, click **“Load To Browser”** again, and your extension updates automatically.


### **Try it yourself: a sticky notes extension**


1. In Neon chat, type: *“Build an extension that lets me add sticky notes to any website, and keeps them there when I come back.”*


1. Add the extension, and pin it to your toolbar if you like.


1. Open any website and try it out.


## **Available now in Opera Neon**


Extension Builder is available today in Opera Neon, where we try out our newest ideas first. We plan to bring it to Opera’s other Desktop browsers later.


**Share your extension with others**


Built something you think others would love? Submit it to the Opera add-ons store at[addons.opera.com/developer](https://addons.opera.com/developer/) . Log in with your Opera account, and you’ll find the guidelines and policies there.


Happy building!
